sections.purpose: Describe a small, local-first archive workflow.
sections.conceptualModel: An archive groups selected source files with a compact index.
sections.dataFlow: The reviewer chooses sources, then the tool writes the archive and index.

decisionsLocked.decision: The archive is written beside the selected source directory.

industryInsights.finding: A portable index reduces dependence on one viewer.

scopeNonGoals: Remote synchronization is not part of this change.

deferredIdeas.text: Add archive signing after the local format stabilizes.

glossary.definition: A compact listing of archive contents.

scenarios.given: The user has selected readable files.
scenarios.then: An archive and compact index are written locally.
scenarios.explanation: The index makes the result inspectable without the application.
scenarios.question: Should archiving always write an index?

scenarios.given: A source file becomes unreadable after selection.
scenarios.then: The archive completes and reports the unreadable file by name.
scenarios.explanation: Partial failures should not silently drop content.
scenarios.rationale: Unreadable sources are a common failure mode worth covering explicitly.

scenarios.given: The user archives a large selection.
scenarios.then: An archive and index are written.
scenarios.explanation: The default keeps the index unless the reviewer says otherwise.
scenarios.question: Should the index be skippable?

scenarios.given: The destination runs out of space mid-write.
scenarios.then: The write stops and the partial archive is removed.
scenarios.explanation: A half-written archive is worse than no archive.
scenarios.question: Should a failed write clean up after itself?
scenarios.extraReason: Covers a known failure mode distinct from the other three scenarios.

scenarios.given: The user opens the source picker.
scenarios.then: Only explicitly selected files are archived.
scenarios.explanation: Selection stays explicit and reviewable before writing begins.
scenarios.question: Should selection remain fully explicit?

constraints.text: Archive output goes beside the selected source directory.
constraints.question: Where should the archive be written?

constraints.text: Index entries always use forward slashes for paths, even on Windows.
constraints.question: Should paths use a single separator style?
constraints.originalText: Index entries use forward slashes for paths.

constraints.text: Remote synchronization of archives is out of scope.
constraints.question: Should remote sync be included?

constraints.text: A destination permission check runs before writing begins.
constraints.rationale: Prevents partial writes when the destination becomes read-only mid-run.

assumptions.claim: Selected inputs are readable when writing starts.
assumptions.basis: The workflow selects files before creating the archive.
assumptions.ifWrong: Unreadable sources need a clear per-file error.
assumptions.meaning: The tool can open every selected source file.
assumptions.check: Try a source that becomes unreadable after selection.
assumptions.rulingNote: Confirmed elsewhere; no additional check needed.

blindSpots.title: Filesystem permissions
blindSpots.detail: The destination may not be writable even when sources are readable.

blindSpots.title: Partial writes on interruption
blindSpots.detail: An interrupted write can leave a corrupt archive behind.
blindSpots.acceptance: Atomic rename mitigates this; accepted without a resolving item.

research.summary: Writing to a temporary file and renaming into place avoids partial archives.
research.detail: A rename is atomic on the same filesystem, so an interrupted write never leaves a corrupt destination file.

requirements.text: Write a compressed archive of the selected files.
requirements.detail: Preserve relative paths so the archive is portable across machines.

requirements.text: Report unreadable source files by name instead of failing the whole archive.
requirements.detail: A destination permission check runs first, then per-file read failures are reported by name.

requirements.text: Remove a partial archive when the destination runs out of space mid-write.
requirements.detail: A half-written archive is removed rather than left behind for the reviewer to find.

requirements.text: Archive only the files the user explicitly selected.
requirements.detail: The archive never includes a file the reviewer did not pick, and output is written beside the source directory.

requirements.text: Use forward slashes for index paths, even on Windows.
requirements.detail: A single separator style keeps the index portable across platforms.

requirements.text: Synchronize archives to a remote service.
requirements.detail: Remote synchronization would need accounts and conflict handling, which is out of scope.

states.label: Ready
states.detail: Inputs are selected and the destination is writable.

states.label: Archived
states.detail: The archive and index were written.

states.label: Failed
states.detail: The write stopped and the partial archive was removed.

transitions.event: The user selects files to archive.
The application writes the archive and index.
The destination runs out of space mid-write.
